title: Eli Navarro
body: Route access reads 'emergency and program traffic, unrestricted' with no expiry filled in. Desk log: county line. Reverse: save half the lunch for my son.
rival_reading: An agricultural program could hold the same unrestricted route access to move its own vehicles under the same clearance; a blank expiry does not by itself show anyone was left stranded by a containment order.
gloss: A route-access card leaves 'emergency and program traffic' unrestricted with no expiry entered.

title: The old copy had the only key
body: The clipboard holds two route copies, with the earlier instruction on top. The key ring is tagged returned, but the delivery field is empty. A bus ticket is folded into the clip.
rival_reading: An agricultural warning could pass through the same office and leave an old copy with a returned key; the empty delivery field may be routine message delay.
gloss: An earlier route instruction travels with a returned key while the delivery field stays empty.
